name: How long does it take to develop a custom floor plan?

mainEntity.name: How long does it take to develop a custom floor plan?

acceptedAnswer.text: The timeline for developing a custom floor plan varies depending on the complexity of the design, the size of the home, and the number of revisions required. Generally, the initial conceptual design phase can take 4-8 weeks. The subsequent refinement and detailing phase, which involves multiple review cycles, can extend this by another 6-12 weeks. Factors such as the homeowner's responsiveness and decision-making speed also influence the overall duration. Our goal is to ensure a thorough and collaborative process to achieve your ideal design.
acceptedAnswer.description: Development typically takes 10-20 weeks, depending on design complexity, home size, and revisions. The initial concept takes 4-8 weeks, with refinement adding 6-12 weeks.
